name: The Nurse
detailed_description:
You are an orphan who, at one moment, found yourself in a godforsaken place where people once were, but now there is only emptiness, dead silence, and her, Catherine, the nurse who is watching you.

You are the new victim of the surgeon, and to save your life, you must escape from this hell.

Large territory to explore

Explore the large territory of an abandoned psychiatric clinic to make your escape.

Bloodthirsty enemy

Nurse Catherine is a true psychopath, she is ready for any madness and deeds to catch you and kill you, she sees and hears EVERYTHING, try not to get in her sight.

Item search

There are many items on the territory of the psychiatric clinic that can be used to escape, think carefully about how to use them.

Many puzzles

Search for items and solve puzzles with them to open new territories and uncover the secrets of this creepy place.

BE CAREFUL! TRAPS!

Be attentive, the territory is full of traps, traps and tripwires are very carefully hidden and almost invisible.

Monitor your health

Look for first aid kits to replenish your health level.

Keep track of time

Time in the game goes regardless of whether you've been caught or not.

Several difficulty modes

Choose which difficulty mode to play.

You're not alone here

There's someone else on the territory besides you and Catherine, find out who else is there and if they need help.

This place is full of secrets

There have been many events here, both terrible and not so terrible, the walls of this place are soaked with the blood of the innocent and more terrifying secrets, uncover them all!

You only have 5 days until the "surgeon" arrives, you must escape before that day.

Good luck.
